📍 Castelfalfi, Montaione, Tuscany, Italy 🇮🇹

Famous for its rolling Tuscan hills 🌿, Castelfalfi has a medieval village feel, old stone buildings, vineyards, olive groves, and peaceful countryside.

Would you visit? What would you explore first?
